content.title: How to play cruise stocks in a a K-shaped economy
content.description:
There are growing concerns about the consumer, with many saying there is a "K-shaped economy" where the wealthiest are spending more while the lower end is pulling back. So what does that mean for leisure spending on things like cruises? Citi leisure & travel analyst James Hardiman explains how to play the cruise industry right now. He also explains why he likes motor sports company BRP (DOO).
